title: English File Upper-Intermediate, File 7: must have, should have; looks, sounds, feels (check against the book)

fixIt.text: You must have saw the sign.
fixIt.explain: must have + past participle: almost sure about the past.
should have + past participle (never has after a modal).

fixIt.text: They can't have went home already.
fixIt.explain: can't have + past participle: sure it did not happen.

fixIt.text: I might have leave my phone in the taxi.
fixIt.explain: might have + past participle: maybe in the past.

fixIt.text: You didn't need to cook, but you should have bring a drink.

fixIt.explain: After look, taste, sound, feel, smell: an adjective.

fixIt.text: It sounds as a great idea.
fixIt.explain: sound like + noun; sound as if + clause.

radio.title: The lost keys
radio.text: Last night my husband could not find his motorbike keys. He said he must have left them at the office, but I thought he might have dropped them in the market. We looked everywhere. In the end, they were in the fridge: he must have put them there with the milk. It sounds funny now, but at the time he looked really worried. He should have used the key hook by the door.
